notes: «قال وحدثني القاسم» : Abu Qilaba is the speaker who says he heard it from القاسم, so the chain runs on through him (rule 3 pattern, one route)
«وأنا لحديث القاسم أحفظ» is Abu Qilaba's own remark and is left out
«كنا عند أبي موسى» is a place; Abu Musa then speaks the report («فلأحدثكم»), so he is the last link (rule 6)
